name: The Troll Witchdoctor
summary: Nazeer Bloodpike means to learn what happened around Marg Nighteye's death, and says only the witch-magic of trolls can tell. You carry Marg's head to Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: Witch-Magic of the Trolls
sections.body: After the severed head turned up, Nazeer Bloodpike insists the events around Marg's death must be known, and that only troll witch-magic can reveal them. Marg's head is to go to Kin'weelay in Stranglethorn Vale, at Grom'gol Base Camp. Among the Darkspear trolls no witchdoctor is mightier than Kin'weelay, and Nazeer reckons that Kin'weelay, if anyone, can reach Marg's spirit.

sections.title: Words at Grom'gol
sections.body: Kin'weelay senses an angry spirit about you as you arrive. Looking at the head, the witchdoctor sees that the orc's spirit is bound in this world, boiling with rage over a duty left undone, and proposes to have words with it.

faq.q: Why must Marg Nighteye's head be taken to Stranglethorn Vale?
faq.answer: Nazeer Bloodpike says the only way to learn the events of Marg's death is the witch-magic of trolls, and Kin'weelay is at Grom'gol Base Camp.
The mightiest witchdoctor among the Darkspear trolls, found at Grom'gol Base Camp in Stranglethorn Vale.
The next step is Marg Speaks.
